title: Select template overloads by type
description: Substitution Failure Is Not An Error (SFINAE) removes a template candidate when substituting its type arguments fails. You can see enable_if express two type conditions.

steps.description: The first square template uses is_arithmetic_v to enable its default type parameter for arithmetic types.
The second template uses the opposite condition. Its extra parameter distinguishes the template declarations.
Both function bodies multiply x by itself. The second body still requires a type that supports that expression.
